cohort: 24 patients who developed iatrogenic vesico-vaginal fistulae (VVF) after hysterectomy, caesarean section, or hysterectomy and pelvic lymphadenectomy
finding: VLR successfully repaired VVF in all patients with primary and persistent VVF.
mod_finding: This study described a surgical technique for repairing vesico-vaginal fistulae (VVF) that occurred after hysterectomy, cesarean section, or hysterectomy and pelvic lymphadenectomy but did not compare outcomes by mode of delivery.
